name: Gmail
layout_summary: Top header: Gmail logo at left, centered 'Search mail' input bar, settings/apps/profile icons at top-right. Left sidebar: prominent 'Compose' button at top-left, followed by Inbox, Starred, Snoozed, Sent, Drafts folders. Center pane: email thread list or open email conversation with Reply/Forward buttons at bottom.
avoid_traps: In the compose modal, pressing 'enter' inside the message body inserts a newline rather than sending — use ctrl+enter or click the blue 'Send' button at bottom-left of the compose pane.
Single-key shortcuts ('c', 'r', 'e') require Gmail keyboard shortcuts to be active or no text input focused; always fall back to smart_click if the compose/reply box does not appear.

search_mail.visual_fallback: smart_type('Search mail box at top center', query, submit=true)
search_mail.verify: Email list updates to show matching messages

compose.verify: New Message compose window opens at bottom-right

reply.primary: smart_click('Reply button at bottom of email')
reply.verify: Reply editor box opens at the bottom of the email thread

archive.visual_fallback: smart_click('Archive box with down arrow icon in top action bar')
archive.verify: Conversation is archived from the Inbox
